findings.rootCause: Inline field values used font-weight 650 almost universally and premium rows used generalized <b>, flattening hierarchy.
findings.mutation: Body values reduced to medium weight; premium rows use ordinary values with strong total only; title/KPI hierarchy preserved.

findings.rootCause: Canonical model supports taxable base, but summary rendered the missing value as a completion warning and used ambiguous label.
findings.mutation: Model retained; UI renders 'Base imponible para IVA' only when authoritative value exists.
findings.proofRequired: Policy with base and policy without base; no invented value and no empty summary noise.

findings.finding: Forma de pago and Conducto duplicated
findings.rootCause: Read normalizer cross-fell back formaPago<-conductoPago and conducto<-formaPago; I6.4 source contract imports them separately.
findings.mutation: Cross-fallback removed. formaPago reads formaPago/metodoPago; conducto reads conducto/conductoPago; frequency stays separate.
findings.proofRequired: Runtime records with distinct values and legacy missing values; write/readback stays distinct.

findings.finding: Existing policy edit did not persist in human flow
findings.rootCause: Prior authenticated PASS never edited a policy field; it edited only vehicle color. Engine also required motivo only for a subset of critical fields, while UI declared motive mandatory. Exact human-field failure remains runtime-discriminant pending.
findings.mutation: Every existing-policy update now requires motive; UI validates clearly before submit; authenticated proof now edits sumaAsegurada, asserts empty-motive zero write, valid-motive backend readback and reload.
findings.proofRequired: Synthetic existing policy same ID: empty motive block -> valid save -> Firestore readback -> reload.

findings.finding: Policy/vehicle relationship ambiguous for reported client
findings.owner: canonical Firestore read models + relationship audit tool
findings.rootCause: Not assumed. Human evidence can represent distinct historical/current contracts plus an incomplete active vehicle link; physical IDs must decide.
findings.mutation: No data mutation. Read-only forensic script added for exact client and reported policy numbers.
findings.proofRequired: Artifact evidence with hashed IDs, states, links, receipt/portfolio counts and classification; no merge/delete.

findings.mutation: Dedicated openVehicleForm(vehicleId) added; actions call editarVehiculo(vehicleId); engine performs same-ID vehicle update through policy atomic write plan.

findings.rootCause: Legacy row/identity renderers allowed literal string 'undefined'/'null' to pass through.
findings.mutation: Vehicle labels and row values normalize null/undefined literals to neutral display values; identity concatenation filters invalid literals.
findings.proofRequired: Authenticated vehicle cards/detail no literal undefined/null.

findings.finding: Receipts partial render then full list
findings.rootCause: Cliente360 rendered legacy receipts first; canonical bridge replaced it in setTimeout(0), creating a visible partial-state race.
findings.mutation: Canonical patch/render now executes synchronously after the original tab/render handler; canonical owner keeps stable loading state until both receipt and portfolio collections are server-confirmed.
findings.proofRequired: Authenticated cold route/tab/reload; no partial row count before canonical dataset.

findings.finding: Receipt detail technical language/harsh hierarchy/duplicate status

findings.mutation: Soft mature-family hero; medium body typography; deduplicated badges; raw authority/match codes suppressed; operational labels for update date/document/match.
findings.proofRequired: Authenticated receipt detail desktop/mobile; no release/gate/validator/internal codes or duplicate payment status.
